description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Amendment to the Regulations on Prohibited Tobacco Products published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1982/33 of 01.09.2016
reasoning: The gazette content pertains to the amendment of regulations under the National Authority on Tobacco and Alcohol Act.
